---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
---

Lake Constance, where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet, is the starting region for these mallard tracks. The supplied `data/mallards.csv` contains timestamped GPS fixes for tagged mallards (*Anas platyrhynchos*) from 2007 to 2017. Their locations extend east across central Europe, reaching about 24°E.

The recorded speeds tend to be higher in July through September than in spring or winter, suggesting a late-summer movement period. Explore individual GPS fixes on the [Map](map.qmd), or compare monthly speed distributions on [Seasons](seasons.qmd).
